questions.scenario: You are working on a word processing document to create an invoice for a client. The invoice includes the following items: Item A costing $50, Item B costing $75, and Item C costing $120. Sales tax is 8%.

issues.label: 9c
issues.detail: Question 9c has 3 marking criteria but questions 1c, 3c, 6c, 8c, 10c have only 2 criteria for the same conceptual question. Inconsistent marking rubric for equivalent questions.
issues.correction: Standardize marking criteria across all part-c questions to 2 or 3 consistent criteria.

issues.label: Assessment overall
issues.detail: Assessment contains 30 questions across 10 question sets. Approximately 60% of questions are exact or near-exact duplicates of earlier questions. Only 4 unique numerical scenarios exist (Items A/B/C 8%, Items X/Y/Z 10%, Items D/E/F 7%, Items X/Y/Z 6%), with the last scenario repeated 4 times. This severely limits assessment validity and student learning differentiation.
issues.correction: Reduce to 10-15 unique questions with varied contexts, item costs, tax rates, and conceptual angles. Maintain one question set per unique scenario rather than repeating identical calculations.

review.summary: Assessment contains 30 questions with severe duplication: 60% are identical or near-identical repeats. Only 4 unique numerical scenarios exist; one repeats 4 times. Metadata inconsistencies in questions 2a-2c. Marking criteria inconsistent for equivalent questions (9c has 3 criteria vs. 2 for similar questions). Recommend consolidation to 10-15 distinct questions with varied contexts and tax rates.
